summary: Full backend + frontend testing of /convenios (Aliados/B2B) feature. 10/10 pytest cases passing (POST /api/partners: happy-path, honeypot drop, offer_type/whatsapp/email/empty validations, 429 rate-limit, email_log confirmation+admin entries with bypass_env_suppression, sitemap /convenios entry, /aliados route reachable). Frontend Playwright: hero title, BETA badge, 4 benefit cards, 3 steps, doc.title & canonical tag correct, CTA scrolls to form, empty-submit shows 8 inline errors (Spanish), invalid email/whatsapp/missing accept_public flagged, happy-path submit swaps to SuccessBlock '¡Gracias! 🎉 Recibimos tu solicitud'. /aliados client-side redirects to /convenios. /promocion nav+footer 'Convenios' links present and navigate correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Rate-limit uses ISO-string comparison on created_at; works because now_iso format is lexicographically sortable, but a real Date type + TTL would be more robust.
PartnerIn.website honeypot is Optional but validator not applied — fine, since honeypot only inspected in the endpoint.
Consider adding indexed compound (email, created_at) for the rate-limit query; single-field index on email exists but $or with client_ip may collscan under load.
test_credentials: Not required — /convenios is a public route.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest test uses unique UUID-based emails; docs cleaned up after each assertion. No lingering TEST_ data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Convenios landing + POST /api/partners is fully green. Emails are logged as status='sent' in email_log; the admin_new_partner notification correctly bypasses ENVIRONMENT='preview' suppression via bypass_env_suppression=True. If regressing, run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration26_partners.py -v.
